title: Apply detekt and ktfmt plugins in app/build.gradle.kts with configuration
description:
Apply both plugins and add configuration blocks to app/build.gradle.kts:

1. Add to plugins {} block:
   alias(libs.plugins.detekt)
   alias(libs.plugins.ktfmt)

2. Add detekt configuration block:
   detekt {
       config.setFrom("$rootDir/detekt.yml")
       buildUponDefaultConfig = false
       allRules = false
       source.setFrom("src/main/kotlin", "src/main/java")
       exclude("**/generated/**")
       exclude("**/test/**")
       exclude("**/androidTest/**")
   }

3. Add ktfmt configuration block:
   ktfmt {
       kotlinStyle = com.ncorti.ktfmt.gradle.style.Style.GoogleStyle()
       targetCharset = "UTF-8"
       googleMaxLineLength = 100
   }

Acceptance criteria:

- ktfmt config block is present with Google style and 100-char width
- ./gradlew help runs without errors (Gradle sync succeeds)
